newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela tax amnesty law brings in $56 million.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela tax amnesty law brings in $56 million.

text.p: Venezuela's tax forgiveness law, which allows late payers to meet overdue tax bills without penalty, has brought in 28 billion bolivars ($56 million) in tax payments, national tax superintendency Seniat said.
"That has topped our IMF target by some 35 percent," Seniat head Edgar Paredes Pisani told reporters.
Pisani said just over 9,000 people had taken advantage of the law, and that nearly 8,000 had so far paid.
